subject: Post-discovery: schedule 30-min orientation + nominate tech SME
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.k@redwoodinference.com>
To: Amelia Ross <amelia.ross@luminahealth.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.k@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Post-discovery: schedule 30-min orientation + nominate tech SME

Hi Amelia — thanks again for a great discovery today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can keep momentum: 

- Recap: main goals are 1) accelerate ingest of anonymized patient notes into embeddings, 2) drive sub-second reranking for search flows, and 3) validate inference cost targets for steady-state traffic.
- Next step: 30-minute orientation/demo (high-level product + quick infra Q&A) with your suggested stakeholders.

To make scheduling painless, can you please pick one of the two overlapping windows below (we tried to maximize overlap between your AM and our engineering hours):

Option A — Wed Dec 23, 2026 • 10:00–10:30 PT / 13:00–13:30 ET
Option B — Thu Dec 24, 2026 • 11:30–12:00 PT / 14:30–15:00 ET

Request: please nominate a single technical SME (infra/ML infra) who can join for 10–15 minutes during the demo so we can surface sizing and security constraints up front. If both work, indicate preferred slot and SME name/email.

I'll attach a one-page milestone map and a draft mutual action plan to align success criteria before the demo. If there are any calendar restrictions (holiday blocks, regional EODs), flag them and we can adjust.

Thanks — Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference — developer-first inference platform
Attach: lumina_milestone_map.pdf (summary), MAP-v1.xlsx (draft mutual action plan)
From: Amelia Ross <amelia.ross@luminahealth.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.k@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.k@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Dec 2026 10:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: schedule 30-min orientation + nominate tech SME

Vivek — thanks for the concise recap and for sending the MAP. Good summary.

We can do Option A (Wed, Dec 23 at 13:00 ET). I'll invite the following people: 
- Amelia Ross (product lead) — me
- Daniel Park (Platform Lead) — daniel.park@luminahealth.com (he can act as SME)
- Priya Shah (Security) — priya.shah@luminahealth.com (observing; will flag anything security related)

One ask: can you include a 5–10 minute section on how Redwood handles key rotation/audit logs (we have a short security checklist to cover). Also please send a calendar invite with the preferred slot and a short agenda (10 min product, 10 min technical sizing, 10 min Q&A).

Thanks — Amelia
Amelia Ross | Head of Product, Lumina Health
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.k@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.k@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Dec 2026 10:25:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: schedule 30-min orientation + nominate tech SME

Noted — locking Option A on my side and I'll own the technical portion. Planning notes for the demo: 
- I'll open with a 2-slideinfra diagram showing our private VPC and KMS/HSM integration points (addresses Amelia's key rotation/audit logs ask).
- Sizing: quick rule-of-thumb chart for concurrent sessions and expected CPU/GPU need based on token/sec.
- Bring a short fallback plan: model variant routing + cache/hit-rate expectations.

Vivek — I can draft the 30-min agenda and share it here. Also: do we want to include the draft MAP as an action item in the invite so Lumina can edit? If yes, I can attach the MAP-v1.xlsx to the calendar.

Connor O'Brien | Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.k@redwoodinference.com>
To: Amelia Ross <amelia.ross@luminahealth.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.k@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Dec 2026 11:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: schedule 30-min orientation + nominate tech SME

Thanks Amelia — Option A is locked on our side. Calendar invite sent (Wed Dec 23, 2026 • 13:00–13:30 ET).

Short agenda attached in the invite:
- 0:00–0:02 — Welcome + goals (Vivek)
- 0:02–0:12 — Product walkthrough (Neha)
- 0:12–0:22 — Technical sizing + security touchpoints (Connor)
- 0:22–0:30 — Q&A + next actions (all)

Attachments included: lumina_milestone_map.pdf, MAP-v1.xlsx (editable). I've also added a link to the HubSpot deal record in the invite notes: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/6789012.

If Daniel or Priya want a quick pre-call security-only sync, Connor can jump on a short 15-min slot before the demo — suggest Dec 23 12:30 ET if helpful. Otherwise we'll cover the key rotation/audit logs section during the sizing block.

See you on the 23rd — Vivek
